title: We built an AI-powered prediction market. Looking for beta testers to try to break it.
author: nathanielbuilds
selftext:
My brother and I have been building Twirl, an AI-native prediction market platform.  
The idea is pretty simple: instead of only trading on prediction markets created by a platform, anyone can create their own.  
Twirl AI helps research the question, structure the market, generate resolution criteria and check whether the outcome can actually be resolved.  
You can also trade on existing markets and use AI-generated Market Context to understand what’s happening around a prediction.  
We’ve reached the point where the product works — but we’ve spent so much time building it that we’re probably the worst people to judge whether the UX actually makes sense. 😂  
So I’m looking for people who haven’t seen Twirl before to test it.  
No real money is required. Beta testers can use testnet funds.  
I’d particularly like to know:  
• Did you understand the product without me explaining it?  
• Could you make your first trade?  
• Was the AI Market Context useful?  
• Could you create your own market using AI?  
• Where did you get confused or stuck?  
• Would you actually come back?  
I’m not looking for “this looks cool” feedback. Tell me what sucks.  
You can try the beta here:

twirl.markets

If you test it, drop me a comment. I’ll send you a short feedback form afterwards.  
And I’m happy to test other founders’ products in return.
